decisions.reason: The candidate already requires help text in both the label and field and requires it to persist when the field is empty; the source confirms these existing rules without changing its state.
Keeping visible guidance for empty fields does not change the candidate's underlying editable-text representation or architecture-quality requirement.
The source addresses discoverability when editable content is empty but does not change whether the placeholder clears when a field is activated; the two behaviors can coexist.
The source changes the visibility and duplication of guidance, not its language or the specified Danish placeholder text.
The source does not address the calendar-dropdown selection behavior of date fields.
Empty interactive-field guidance has no effect on pasted-table layout or column containment.
The source does not concern numbered-list alignment or formatting.
The source's visual-field guidance does not alter bullet sizing, balance, alignment, reference design, or color.
The source does not address legacy-content transfer, layout stability, style behavior, or the unresolved copy-paste workflow.
The source does not change Tab-based list-level creation or nested-list hierarchy behavior.
The source does not discuss or modify the required theme colors.
The source does not change any heading, title, or caption typography attribute.
